root.label: DNC files lawsuit over overseas voter postcard change

events.label: DNC files lawsuit over overseas voter postcard change

slots.name: eligible states
slots.sentence: They are usually the children of U.S. citizens, and 38 states allow them to cast ballots provided they have close family connections.

slots.name: overseas voters
slots.sentence: The number of Americans overseas who have never lived in the United States yet cast ballots in the country was estimated at about 11,500 in 2016.

slots.name: daughter age
slots.sentence: Susan Dzieduszycka-Suinat is a U.S. citizen in Munich whose 28-year-old daughter also is a U.S. citizen who has never resided in the country but votes regularly.

slots.name: lawsuit filing date
slots.sentence: The Democratic National Committee on Thursday filed a lawsuit alleging that President Donald Trump’s administration secretly changed a postcard used by U.S. citizens overseas in a way that makes it harder to register to vote.

slots.name: box appearance date
slots.sentence: Since 2013, the box has appeared on postcards sent to overseas voters.
